claim.summary: Captured terminal backbone norm arithmetic is smaller in RMS than its incoming-input effect at384/385. Substituting M(H_N) for N(H_N) on captured native pre-norm input at385, through unchanged native tower HNorm/EH with fixed embedding, leaves both EH failures. This operator-only substitution is insufficient; the MLX diagonal M(H_M) was not substituted.
not_claimed: causal attribution to layer39 or historical KV

risk_and_recovery: CAUTION bounded diagnostics. No production edits; revert the evidence/documentation commit to roll back. Do not run services or reuse diagnostic readbacks in production.

source_under_test.provenance_limit: Selected source and raw BF16 payload pins plus separately observed binaries/plans. No complete five-shard integrity, transitive dependency closure or reproducible source-to-binary build attestation.

workload.prefix_limit: Discrete prefix and mixed input at384/385 are bit-equal; historical backbone KV/SSM and tower KV contents are not identical across backends.

math.norm: Ordinary backbone RMSNorm: x / sqrt(mean(x*x)+1e-6) * weight. Original BF16 backbone.norm.weight is already shifted by the converter; promote to F32 without another +1. Tower HNorm is separately zero-centered.
math.comparison: abs(native-MLX) <= atol + rtol*abs(MLX). F64 analysis of drained F32 vectors does not change GPU arithmetic.

passive_capture.interpretation: At384, the first selected layer-output tolerance excess is layer39 coordinate755; all40 selected outputs at385 pass. Both norm outputs pass. These layer boundary comparisons are descriptive, not same-input layer-operator tests or generation-wide origin evidence.

limits: Immediate four-cell norm sensitivity is conditional on captured F32 inputs and promoted original norm weights.
Layer output/input differences can reflect accumulated activation/KV history; no particular layer is established as the cause.
This isolated norm probe does not rerun the full strict tower logits gate or establish its repair.

terminal_norm_substitution.intervention: Replace only terminal backbone N(H_N) with M(H_N); feed the changed hidden through unchanged native tower HNorm and EH with fixed bit-equal normalized embedding. The original MLX EH reference stays fixed.
limits: Captured local counterfactual; no production norm substitution or complete autoregressive replay with replacement.
Historical backbone and tower KV differences are not removed or attributed.
No precision/tolerance, performance or audio-quality claim changes.

gpu_and_memory_boundary.native_standalone: Each submits/completes/waits once at depth2, no reads before finish; terminal32768 bytes, control0 and diagnostic0, pending/retained0. MLX norm evaluates four outputs once before serialization.
gpu_and_memory_boundary.scope: Private captured-input uploads and terminal diagnostic serialization only. No new production activation/cache transfer or synchronization. Extra passive GPU copies are not performance-neutral, so no speed claim.
gpu_and_memory_boundary.guards: Heavy jobs serial under run_safe; configured15% free-memory threshold, tree RSS8192MiB build/analysis and40960MiB model jobs, finite wrapper and outer timeouts. Logs show preflight, not observed minima. CogniGraph retained bytes are accounting, not physical residency. Studio was not started.

mini_quadrumvirate.prediction: Terminal backbone RMSNorm could be the missing contributor to captured tower EH failures.
mini_quadrumvirate.discriminator: Passive384/385 backbone boundaries with exact parent controls; four crossed GPU norm cells with original diagonals, then operator-only substitution through fixed native HNorm/EH.
mini_quadrumvirate.result: Both EH failures survive terminal-norm-only substitution. Input drift precedes terminal norm; its causal history remains unlocalized.
mini_quadrumvirate.adversary: ROBUST within captured local attribution after source-identity, original-diagonal, tolerance and no-new-production-sync checks. Same-lineage review is correlated, not independent replication.

dod.expected_signal: Artifact and source/plan/receipt hashes match; original diagonals and scalar tolerance summaries recompute; the builder-computed strict38-value FAIL result is pinned; only the three intended repository paths changed.
dod.verification_scope_limit: Final verifier recomputes standalone norm/chain numeric claims. Passive-capture metrics, raw strict-logit gate and source-revision equality belong to separately executed pinned analyses; no independent replication is claimed.
dod.receipt_scope: The final verifier receipt is external to the packet index to avoid self-referential hashing; inspect its actual exit status.
dod.fallback: Direct four-output native HNorm/EH counterfactual reconstructs both original native diagonals and checks every2048 EH value against the unchanged original MLX reference.
